_comment: Merge the mcpServers block below into your real Claude Desktop config.
_location_store_app: If Claude Desktop is the Microsoft Store build, the REAL file Python sees is C:\Users\<you>\AppData\Local\Packages\Claude_pzs8sxrjxfjjc\LocalCache\Roaming\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (the %APPDATA% path is a redirect).
_note: Add 'summarize-agent' inside the existing mcpServers object — do not overwrite other keys. Restart Claude Desktop after editing.
_why_wrapper: Use run_mcp_server.py (NOT '-m backend.mcp_server'). Claude Desktop does not reliably set the working directory, so '-m backend.mcp_server' fails with 'No module named backend'. The wrapper puts the project root on sys.path itself, so it works from any cwd.
